newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close steady on low buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close steady on low buying.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Wednesday on low buying by spinners facing fund shortage, dealers at the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
The market remained depressed in the absence of big spinners, who had already bought cotton for their needs until the end of June, one dealer said.
Some exporters, who have funds, bought low quality cotton, another dealer said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted for 1,950/2,050 rupes per maund, the K-68 for 2,300/2,375 and the MNH-93 for 2,325/2,375.
